## Underground Ranger (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
 Male human ranger 4  
 CG Medium humanoid (human)  

**Init** +3; **Senses** Perception +8  
  
  

**Defense**

   **AC** 18, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+1 dodge, +4 armor, +3 Dex)  

 **hp** 52 (4d10+12)  

 **Fort** +6, **Ref** +7, **Will** +3  
  
  

**Offense**

  
     **Speed** 30 ft.  

**Melee** longsword +5 (1d8+1/19–20)  

**Ranged**  *+1 longbow* +9 (1d8+1/×3)  

**Special Attacks**  favored enemy (undead +2)  

**Spells Prepared**  (CL 1st; concentration +2)  
  1st—
      *[longstrider](../../magic/spells/longstrider.md)*  

**Statistics**

     **Str** 13, **Dex** 17, **Con** 14, **Int** 11, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 10  

**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +5; **CMD** 19  

**Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Point-Blank Shot](../../rules/feats/point-blank-shot.md), Rapid Shot, Weapon Focus (longbow), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md)

**Skills** Climb +7, Handle Animal +7, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +7, Knowledge (local) +3, Knowledge (nature) +7, Perception +8, Stealth +9, Survival +7, Swim +5
